notes: Modified cash basis city (recorded as cash, as FY2023/FY2024). Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis, Total column (p4); the statement rolls fund balances (3,467,490 -> 3,253,671), recorded in the fund balance fields; cash fields left null as in later years (cash lines are on the balance sheets p1, p3). ending_investments = certificates of deposit incl. restricted (p3, computed). Taxes 473,519 split from the General Fund schedule rows (p12; the schedule's Sales tax row 75,735 is in the statement's Sales tax line). Intergovernmental revenues 710,319 split from the General (p12), Street (p16) and ARPA (p23) schedule rows. Other 135,010 split from the General Fund Other rows (p12-13, excluding NPPD lease and interest printed separately on the statement), Street Other (p16), LB 840 loan payments (p20) and Housing loan repayments (p22). Transfers: the Total column prints only the net 'Operating transfers in (out)' (135,091) out (to the enterprise funds); fund columns: General out 52,000, Debt Service out 168,668, Street in 85,577. Sale of assets 119,796 printed under other financing sources -> other_financing. Business-type (Water, Sewer, Garbage) from the modified cash basis proprietary statement (p8), which ties to the Statement of Activities (p2: charges 935,829; expenses 990,512 = operating 968,470 + interest 22,042); measure net position. The separately issued accrual statements of the proprietary funds (p24-30: different amounts, net position 4,998,337) are not used; no business-type detail (as in later years). Proprietary cash flow statement printed (p9-10) but left null as in later years. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), since it includes capital assets and debt. Detail: per-fund budget and actual schedules (General p12-15, Street p16-17, Community Improvement p18, LB 840 p20, Debt Service p21, Housing Development p22, ARPA p23); Economic Development Fund has no 2022 activity (p19). Combined all-funds budget statement (p11) and LB 840 inception-to-date schedule (p31-32) not recorded (would double count). Zero / blank actual lines omitted. Read pages 1-32 of 32
